title: Thompson sampling with Beta beliefs
brief: Keep a Beta belief about each arm, draw one plausible mean per arm, and play the largest draw.
hints: With a uniform Beta(1, 1) prior, the posterior after S successes and F failures is Beta(1 + S, 1 + F): add one to each count.
rng.beta(a, b) with array arguments draws one sample per arm in one call. Thompson sampling plays the argmax of the samples, never of the posterior means.
For prob_best, rng.beta(a, b, size=(n_samples, k)) draws every round at once. np.argmax(samples, axis=1) names each round's winner, and np.bincount counts them.
The probabilities from prob_best must add up to 1, because every round has exactly one winner.
